mapper.select: SELECT nb.id as id, nb.title as title, pf.nickname as authorName, nb.view_cnt as viewCnt, nb.author_id as authorId, nb.created_at as createdAt, nb.updated_at as updatedAt FROM notice_board nb JOIN user u ON nb.author_id = u.id JOIN profile pf ON pf.user_id = u.id WHERE nb.is_removed = false ORDER BY nb.created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT nb.id as id, nb.title as title, pf.nickname as authorName, nb.view_cnt as viewCnt, nb.author_id as authorId, nb.created_at as createdAt, nb.updated_at as updatedAt FROM notice_board nb JOIN user u ON nb.author_id = u.id JOIN profile pf ON pf.user_id = u.id WHERE nb.is_removed = false and nb.author_id = #{userId} ORDER BY nb.created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageRequest.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageRequest.offset}

SELECT nb.id as notice_id, nb.title as title, pf.nickname as authorName, nb.author_id as authorId, nb.content as content, nb.view_cnt as viewCnt, nb.created_at as createdAt, nb.updated_at as updatedAt,
/* 게시글 이미지 (N) */ nip.id as img_id, nip.saved_file_name as img_name, nip.path as img_path, nip.size as img_size, nip.content_type as img_content_type, /* 프로필 이미지 (1) */ pip.id as pip_img_id, pip.saved_file_name as pip_img_name, pip.path as pip_img_path, pip.size as pip_img_size, pip.content_type as pip_img_content_type
FROM notice_board nb JOIN user u ON nb.author_id = u.id JOIN profile pf ON pf.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN profile_image_property pip ON pf.id = pip.profile_id LEFT JOIN notice_board_image_property nip ON nb.id = nip.board_id
WHERE nb.id = #{id} AND nb.is_removed = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice_board (author_id, title, content, view_cnt, is_removed, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{viewCnt}, #{isRemoved}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt});
mapper.update: UPDATE notice_board SET is_removed = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id};
